templates.body: The {name} has a secret weapon. Look at how it uses its {abilities} to hunt. In the blink of an eye, it uses a {moves} to snag its prey in the {habitat}. It's {active_time}, and this {animal_class} is hungry. Science is fast, guys! Don't look away.

This {animal_class} has very distinct {abilities} for walking on sand. It's {active_time}, and the trail is fresh. Let's see if we can find it and witness its {moves}!

templates.body: Look at this little guy! It's a hatchling {name}. Even as a baby, this {animal_class} has all its {abilities} ready to go. It's {active_time} in the {habitat}, and it's already practicing its {moves}. It might be cute, but it's still a wild animal. Life finds a way!

This {animal_class} uses its {abilities} to communicate over miles. Each sound corresponds to a different {moves}. The language of the wild is beautiful!

templates.body: We've found a {name} that's been preserved in the ice! This is a major {animal_class} discovery. By studying its {abilities}, we can learn how it survived the {habitat} thousands of years ago. We can even see the structures for its {moves}. History is coming alive today!

templates.body: And... it's gone! The {name} just disappeared underground. This {animal_class} has incredible digging {abilities}. We're in the {habitat} during the {active_time} to time its {moves}. It can bury itself in under three seconds! Absolutely spectacular engineering. Stay wild!

templates.body: Turn off the lights... look! The {name} is bio-luminescent! This {animal_class} is glowing in the {habitat}. It uses these {abilities} to attract prey during the {active_time}. When it strikes with a {moves}, it looks like a lightning bolt. Nature is the best light show on Earth!

templates.body: How smart is the {name}? We've set up a puzzle in the {habitat} to find out. This {animal_class} is using its {abilities} to solve the problem during the {active_time}. Watch it use its {moves} to get the reward. It's not just instinct; it's problem-solving! Be brave, stay wild!

templates.body: Look at the colors on those wings! The {name} is taking flight. This {animal_class} has the most beautiful {abilities} in the entire {habitat}. It's {active_time}, and the sky is full of them. Watch the aerial {moves} as it dances through the air. Truly a sight to behold!
templates.author: Coyote Peterson

templates.headline: Coyote Peterson's Ultimate {name} Guide
templates.body: I'm putting everything I know about the {name} into one place. From its {habitat} habits to its most dangerous {moves}, we're covering it all. This {animal_class} is a testament to the wonder of the natural world. Its {abilities} is unmatched. Remember: be brave, stay wild!
templates.author: Coyote Peterson

templates.headline: The {name} Final Mission
templates.body: This is our last day in the {habitat} for this expedition. We've finally tracked down the elusive {name}. Look at the {abilities} one last time. It's {active_time}, and the sun is setting on an incredible journey. It just performed its {moves} for us. What a perfect ending. Stay wild!
templates.author: Coyote Peterson

templates.headline: {habitat} Survival: {name} Territory
templates.body: Survival in the {habitat} is all about protein. The {name} is a dangerous {diet}, but if you can catch one, its {drops} will keep you alive for days. To stay safe, you need to watch out for its {attack} attack. Remember: stay calm, and never lose your edge.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: {habitat} Mastery: The {name} Threat
templates.body: Listen closely. In the {habitat}, the {name} isn't just an animal; it's a living obstacle. As a {diet}, it's evolved to find you before you find it. To survive an encounter with its {attack} attack, you have to be smarter, faster, and willing to do whatever it takes. Your life depends on it.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: Protein is King: Harvesting {name} {drops}
templates.body: In a survival situation, your body is an engine that needs fuel. The {name} is prime energy. Catching this {animal_class} is a gamble, especially with that {attack} attack looming, but the reward of fresh {drops} is the difference between making it out of the {habitat} or becoming part of the landscape.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: The {habitat} Gauntlet: {name} Ambush
templates.body: The {habitat} doesn't forgive mistakes. The {name} is a master of the {diet} lifestyle, waiting for you to let your guard down. If you see that {attack} attack coming, drop your pack and move! Survival is about grit, and nothing tests your grit like a face-off with a wild {name}.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: Emergency Calories: {name} {drops} on the Go
templates.body: You're cold, you're tired, and you're miles from safety in the {habitat}. This is where you find out who you really are. Securing {drops} from a {name} is dangerous work, but this {animal_class} provides the fats you need to keep your core temperature up. Eat fast, move faster.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: Respect the {habitat}: Navigating {name} Lairs
templates.body: Every step in the {habitat} is a choice. Entering {name} territory means you're playing by their rules now. This {diet} doesn't take kindly to intruders. Keep your eyes peeled for signs of its {attack} attack. If you're lucky enough to take it down, those {drops} will be your ticket home.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: Improvised Hunting: Trapping the {name}
templates.body: Work with the {habitat}, not against it. To catch a {name}, you need to understand the mind of a {diet}. Build your trap strong, because one slip-up and you're facing a {attack} attack head-on. Once you've secured the {drops}, you've secured your survival for another night.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: The Survival Mindset: Facing the {name}
templates.body: Survival is 90% mental. When a {name} charges with its {attack} attack, your instinct is to freeze. Don't. Use the {habitat} to your advantage. This {animal_class} is tough, but you are tougher. Claim those {drops}, stoke your fire, and keep moving toward extraction.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: Primitive Cooking: Charring {name} {drops}
templates.body: You've survived the {name} and its lethal {attack} attack. Now comes the reward. In the deep {habitat}, we don't worry about flavor; we worry about survival. Sear the {drops} over white-hot coals to kill off any {animal_class} parasites. It's tough, it's gamey, but it's life.

templates.body: To eat like a king, you have to hunt like a pro. Look for disturbed earth and {animal_class} tracks. The {name} leaves a trail if you know how to read it. Stay downwind to avoid its {attack} attack. Those {drops} are out there—go get them. Stay sharp.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: Extreme Endurance: The {name} Marathon
templates.body: The {habitat} will try to break you. Don't let it. If a {name} is stalking you, it's a test of will. This {diet} is relentless, but so are you. Avoid the {attack} attack at all costs, and if you manage to harvest the {drops}, you've earned your place at the top of the food chain.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.body: Silence is your greatest weapon. Move through the {habitat} like a ghost. The {name} has keen senses, and its {attack} attack is nothing to joke about. If you can get the drop on this {animal_class}, you'll have enough {drops} to survive a week. Improvising, adapting, overcoming.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.body: Find water, find food, find shelter. In the {habitat}, the {name} often gathers near the lifeblood of the land. It's a dangerous place to hunt, especially with that {attack} attack, but the {drops} are too valuable to pass up. Stay hydrated, stay focused, stay alive.

templates.body: Never build your camp in the middle of a {name} run. This {diet} won't hesitate to use its {attack} attack if it feels cornered. If you must hunt it, do it away from where you sleep. Secure the {drops} and move your kitchen downwind. The {habitat} is watching.

templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: High-Altitude Survival: {name} in the Peaks
templates.body: The air is thin and the {habitat} is freezing. Here, the {name} is at its most desperate. As a {diet}, it's looking for an easy meal—don't let that be you. Deflect the {attack} attack and claim the {drops}. In these conditions, those calories are literally worth their weight in gold.

templates.body: In the {habitat}, everything has a use. Beyond just the {drops}, the {name} offers resources for those who know where to look. Just watch the {attack} attack while you're closing in. Being a {diet} means it's always ready for a scrap. Be ready to give it one.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.body: If you can't fight, hide. Use mud and foliage from the {habitat} to mask your scent. The {name} is a keen tracker, and its {attack} attack can end your journey in seconds. Wait for your moment, then strike to claim the {drops}. It's about being the apex, not the prey.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.body: When the {habitat} turns to ice, survival gets real. The {name} is your best source of concentrated energy. You'll have to work hard to avoid the {attack} attack in the snow, but the {drops} provide the insulation your body needs. Never give up. Never surrender.

templates.body: Humidity can kill you just as fast as a {name}. In this dense {habitat}, visibility is zero. You'll hear the {attack} attack before you see it. Stay low, stay quiet, and keep your knife ready. That {animal_class} is made of pure protein—get those {drops} and get out.

templates.body: Heat is the enemy. The {name} is the prize. In the scorching {habitat}, you need to hunt during the cool of the night. Watch for the {attack} attack in the shadows. The {drops} will give you the strength to push through another day of sun. Survival is a state of mind.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.body: Even in a concrete {habitat}, nature takes back what's hers. The {name} has adapted to the wreckage. It's still a dangerous {diet}, and that {attack} attack is just as lethal on asphalt as it is in the dirt. Scavenge the {drops} and keep moving toward the extraction point.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

If you trigger its {attack} attack, you're in for a world of hurt. Be the hunter, not the hunted. Those {drops} are yours for the taking.

templates.headline: The {name} Gauntlet: Forced March
templates.body: You've got ten miles to go and a {name} on your tail. This is the ultimate test of endurance. This {diet} won't quit, and neither can you. Evade the {attack} attack, keep your pace, and if the chance arises, take the {drops}. Every calorie is a mile closer to home.

templates.body: In the {habitat}, a tool is a treasure. After you've taken down a {name} and harvested the {drops}, use the leftovers. This {animal_class} has dense bones perfect for sharpening. It's the circle of survival: use the {name} to survive the next {attack} attack.

templates.body: The sound of a {name} in the {habitat} can paralyze a person with fear. Don't let it. That roar is just a prelude to its {attack} attack. Control your breathing. Focus on the {drops} you need to stay alive. The wild is won in the mind before it's won on the ground.

templates.body: Fire is life. It cooks your {drops}, keeps you warm, and keeps the {name} at bay. A {diet} fears the flame. Use a torch to redirect a {attack} attack and show the {habitat} who's boss. Stay behind the light and stay alive.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: Baiting the Hook: Luring the {name}
templates.body: Sometimes you have to bring the fight to them. Use local {habitat} resources to lure the {name} into a bottleneck. It's high risk—one slip and you're feeling the {attack} attack—but it's the most efficient way to get a massive haul of {drops}. fortune favors the brave.

templates.body: Crossing water is always a gamble. The {name} knows you're slow in the river. Watch for the {attack} attack while you're waist-deep. If you can secure the {drops} on the far bank, you'll have the energy to push through the rest of the {habitat}. Stay vigilant.

templates.body: Going underground is a last resort. The {name} uses these tunnels for shelter. It's tight, it's dark, and the {attack} attack is impossible to dodge in close quarters. If you manage to bag the {drops}, you've conquered the hardest part of the {habitat}. Move with purpose.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.body: The tall grass hides everything. The {name} is watching you from the golden sea of the {habitat}. Its {attack} attack is lightning fast. Keep your back to a tree and your eyes on the horizon. Secure the {drops}, build a signal fire, and wait for rescue. You can do this.

templates.body: You don't always have to be the one to kill. In the {habitat}, search for where a {name} has already fought. You might find {drops} without having to face a {attack} attack. It's not glorious, but survival is about being smart, not being a hero. Take what you find.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: Stealth and Strike: {name} Vulnerability
templates.body: Every {animal_class} has a weak point. Find it on the {name}. Wait for the moment right after it uses its {attack} attack—that's when it's vulnerable. Strike hard, strike fast, and claim those {drops}. The {habitat} rewards the decisive. Stay strong.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: The {name} Trail: Signs of Life
templates.body: Follow the path of the {name} to find resources in the {habitat}. They know where the salt licks and water are. Just be ready for a {attack} attack if you're spotted. Grab the {drops} and use their own trails to escape. It's called adapting. It's what we do.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: Extreme Heat: {name} Dehydration
templates.body: In the desert {habitat}, the {name} is as thirsty as you are. Use this to your advantage at the watering hole. Ambush the {diet} to avoid its {attack} attack and get the {drops} you need for a high-protein boost. Salt from the meat will help you retain water. Think ahead.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: High Winds: {name} in the Gale
templates.body: The wind is howling through the {habitat}, masking the sound of the {name}. This is when the {attack} attack is most dangerous—you won't hear it coming. Stay low to the ground and move between gusts. Those {drops} are the only thing keeping you going. Keep your chin up.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: The {name} Stand-Off: Eye Contact
templates.body: If you're face-to-face with a {name} in the {habitat}, don't run. Running triggers the {diet} chase instinct. Stand your ground, look it in the eye, and prepare for the {attack} attack. If you win this fight, the {drops} will be the sweetest meal you've ever had. Stay bold.
templates.author: Bear Grylls

templates.headline: Tidal Flats: {name} Quicksand
